title: Data-Gated Pipeline
constraints: Three pipeline stages. Stage 1 registers `in_data ^ 8'h5A`, stage 2 registers `s1 + 1`, stage 3 registers `s2` rotated left by one bit. The valid bits always advance, one stage per cycle.

**Data gating:** a stage's data register loads **only** when the valid bit entering it is 1. Otherwise it keeps its old value, so a bubble never toggles the data flops (and synthesis can turn these enables into clock gates).
So during bubbles `out_data` holds the last valid result. Synchronous reset clears the valid bits **and** the data registers.
hints: Each data register gets `if (v_prev) d <= f(d_prev);`, which is a clock enable.
The valid bits are cheap (1 bit each) and always clocked. The wide data registers are the ones worth gating.

examples.title: hold
examples.input: a bubble follows a valid item
